mainEntity.name: How much does permit and inspection coordination support cost, and is it worth it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost is not just the permit fee; it can also include plan-prep time, resubmittals, and coordination work if multiple inspections are needed. Denver requires fees to be paid through the permitting system, and the total value of support is often avoiding costly rework or inspection delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on project complexity and how much coordination is needed. It is often worth it if the support helps avoid failed inspections, resubmittals, and project delays.
